## Draft Desk: replies
Every 15 minutes Grok looks for fresh, rising posts. Each one is checked against X's public embed data (real text, real likes, real age). Claude Code writes 0-2 replies; Telegram gives you a **Reply on X** button. The pipeline never posts: since 23 Feb 2026 the X API refuses replies to posts that did not mention you.

1. Edit **config**.
2. Pick your Telegram credential.
3. Edit prompts/watchlist.txt.
